steps.note: Victoria recruited, Zero Day's share already stopped at the console: Give me a minute defers, then Open it is free of cost. She stays on the player's side and the credits keep her.

said: Take it. Zero Day won't wait for ever, and neither will I.
Their share's dead, so they've nothing left to pay me with. That makes me yours. Go on.
notSaid: Zero Day still pays, and you don't.

said: Go on. It's open, and I'm still on your side.
notSaid: I told you not to follow me.

said: VICTORIA STERLING: Opened the lock. Still ours.
